_about: Probe scenarios for tools/test/run.py probe. Each runs the game headless (unbanished --boot-capture) with these arguments, records the --probe answers and compares them with tools/test/baselines/<name>.json. Times are seconds of game capture time; the capture is 1280x720. See docs/develop/TESTING.md.

main-menu.about: The main menu and the New Game dialog: their buttons, edits and combos.

new-game.about: A new game (seed 1234, Testwood): the town at the start and after four minutes at speed 10.

camera.about: After a new game: the camera before and after holding W (moves), holding E (turns), two wheel steps (zooms) and a 200-pixel drag with the rotate button (turns), sent as the desktop window handler sends them.
